description.value: Bravo Restaurant and Lounge is a casually elegant fine-dining spot in downtown Chilliwack specializing in Pacific Northwest cuisine, offering an innovative dinner menu alongside an extensive martini and wine list. The intimate yet social atmosphere makes it a standout evening destination on the Fraser Valley cycling corridor. A private lounge is available for group events, and Wi-Fi is available throughout.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website is fully accessible and confirms Bravo is an operating fine-dining restaurant serving Pacific Northwest cuisine in Chilliwack. Wi-Fi is explicitly stated ('Bravo is Wi-fi friendly for your conference or personal needs.'). A phone number (604.792.7721) appears on the contact page, which is absent from OSM; no other cyclist-specific amenities (bike parking, washrooms, takeout, water refill) are mentioned anywhere on the site. The OSM name uses '&' while the website spells out 'and', a minor discrepancy flagged below.
concerns: OSM name uses '&' ('Bravo Restaurant & Lounge') while the website consistently spells out 'and' ('Bravo Restaurant and Lounge').
OSM record has no phone number; phone 604.792.7721 sourced from website contact page only.
Website describes location as 'downtown Chilliwack' but OSM address is 46224 Yale Road — these may not be the same location; worth verifying coordinates match the actual downtown premises.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, operating fine-dining restaurant in Chilliwack with an active website and confirmed contact details; a useful dinner stop for touring cyclists on the Fraser Valley route.
